Definition: a sybil tax is a non-refundable genesis levy of 90 units per identity, locked 4 epochs, 15% refunded per honest epoch.

The atlas of new identities is priced at entry: forgery burns the remainder and freezes the identity 8 epochs. A walnut-sized actor pays once and earns it back; a factory pays per clone.

The delta: 1,000 clones prepay 90,000; a 30% detection rate burns 27,000. Capital cannot cycle; bulk forgery is priced out.
